findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed an employee did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet after hand washing. The employee was educated when the action was observed. Management will be focusing on hand washing education for employees. Ensure that a barrier is always used to turn off the faucet to avoid re-contaminating clean hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed the prep line floors underneath equipment (ex. grills, deep fryers, heat lamp) have an accumulation of food debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil residues. Ensure that the floors underneath equipment on the food prep line are clean to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: The interior of the creamer machine on the frontline is observed with an accumulation of frost. Defrost the machine so the surfaces are easily cleanable. 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be cleaned as frequently as necessary to remain clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13:  The interior door of the creamer machine has a slight accumulation of soil. See that the creamer machine receives maintenance and cleaning attention so surfaces are observed in good repair and clean. 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
